versions.changelog:
No changes detected in this version.

- No file changes were made compared to the previous version.
- All features and documentation remain as before.

**Major update: Comprehensive upgrade of the video storyboard guidance system.**

- Integrated knowledge from 17 classic storyboard and shot design books, covering a full production pipeline: narrative strategy → shot language → character/asset design → image generation.
- Supports all video types: short video, marketing video, long-form narrative, with automatic content and emotional analysis to select specialized reference frameworks.
- Detailed step-by-step instructions: from input/script analysis to story structure, scene/character/prop design, and technical image prompt generation for consistency with AI-driven visual tools.
- Standardized storyboard tables with industry-best practices, including lens, angle, camera movement, duration, and key narrative elements.
- Extensive quick-reference guides for shot/angle/movement selection and scene-specific camera packages.
- Built-in quality checklists for narrative, shot structure, and pacing, ensuring cinematic coherence and production readiness.
